narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -5.10 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.01207-0.01242 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.01252; the first objective pays 0.83R at 0.01199.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.01252 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.01 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 25/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $2.1M -1.8% below · short liq $613k +3.8% above
